name: NYS DEC Summer Camps (Colby, DeBruce, Pack Forest, Rushford)
org: New York State Department of Environmental Conservation (DEC)
city: New York State (camps in Franklin County, the Catskills, Allegany County and the southern Adirondacks)
what_you_do: Spend a week at a DEC camp. You learn outdoor skills like backpacking, canoeing and fishing. You study habitats and ecology. Some weeks offer hunter education.
who_can_apply: Youth 14 to 17 can go to the weeks set aside for that age. Campers must be the minimum age by December 1 of the calendar year. The pages do not state a residency rule.
pay_detail: $350 per camper per week, with meals and trips included. Transportation to and from camp is not included. Many campers are sponsored by local conservation groups, clubs and community groups.
duration: One week, Sunday afternoon to Friday afternoon (2026 teen weeks ran July 12 to Aug 7, depending on the camp)
deadline_text: Registration for 2026 opened Sunday March 22, 2026 at 1 PM and weeks fill quickly (waitlist available). 2027 dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Set up a family account in the DEC online registration system. Fill out the camper forms and waivers in the Document Center before registration opens. Then register for a week and pay online. If a week is full, join the waitlist.
notes: This is a camp for campers, not a job. The main camp page still mentions a March 2025 opening, so use the How to Register page for dates. Ask DEC about sponsorships early.
